{{Quote|Not a whimper. I believe her son is a Tyro.|Yuvar Xal, on Zin's death|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
The '''son''' of [[Sith Saber]] [[Axela Zin]] was a [[Sith Tyro|Tyro]] in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith Tribe]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], Axela Zin was selected as a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] sent to recover the [[Sith Meditation Sphere|Meditation Sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] and [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. During the mission, Zin died honorably, and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea]] declared that her [[Gender/Legends|son]] would be given a [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] upon the team's return. However, before they could return, the team was nearly [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|eliminated]], yielding only [[Vestara Khai|one]] surviving member.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Make a note, Vestara.''"<br />"''Her name is noted. Did you wish to add something about the son?''"<br />"''The boy shall find his Master when we return.|Olaris Rhea and Vestara Khai, after Zin's death|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
[[File:Vestara.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Vestara Khai (pictured) made a note for Axela Zin's son to be trained.]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]<ref name="Abyss" /> by [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=7260#17384444|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-10-02|time=10:48 AM}} dates the beginning of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series to [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. As ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', the third instalment of the series, is dated to 43 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', its events must take place in 43.5 ABY. Therefore, [[Axela Zin]]'s son's [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]] and elevation to [[Sith Tyro]], which ''Abyss'' establishes must have happened before its events, both occurred by 43.5 ABY.</ref> He was the son of the [[Sith Saber]] [[Axela Zin]], and he had become a [[Sith Tyro]] in the planet's [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] within two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Battle of Uroro Station|conclusion]] of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Abyss" /> In 43.5 ABY,<ref name="Date" /> the boy's [[Parent/Legends|mother]] was chosen to be a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] sent to [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|recover]] the [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] and [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="Abyss" />

During the mission, Zin was killed on a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. The [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Yuvar Xal]] noted to the mission's [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea]], that the Sith Saber had died quietly and honorably, and added that Zin's son was a Tyro. Rhea then ordered her [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Vestara Khai]], to [[Writing/Legends|record]] the Saber's name and add that her son would be commended upon the team's return to Kesh by having a Master assigned to [[Sith training|train]] him. However, before they could return to the Tribe's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], the strike team was defeated during their [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|attack]] on Skywalker, yielding Khai as the sole [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] survivor.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Powers and abilities==
Axela Zin's son was Force-sensitive. He was made a Tyro in Kesh's Sith Tribe<ref name="Abyss" /> by 43.5 ABY,<ref name="Date" /> although Rhea planned to initiate his full training in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] by giving him a Master upon the strike team's return to Kesh.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Behind the scenes==
Axela Zin's son was mentioned in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', the third novel in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, written by [[Troy Denning]] and released in [[2009]].<ref name="Abyss" />
